limitations: SCREENING only: one C1 then C64 run, no quality evaluation, no complete candidate matrix or repeated alternating AB/BA trials.
Inference-time JIT events and unmatched warmup histories prevent warmed comparative claims.
The future formal-comparison protocol v5 is separate; v3 screens are not pooled with v5 trials.
No outlier removal; all request rows and reported metrics are retained.
PCM sample frames/s is reported, not codec frames/s.
